name: Cantilever lumber rack
summary: Wall cantilever lumber rack: three steel uprights, five arm levels of 2x4s, 1x6s, 2x6s, trim and hardwood, plywood offcuts leaning below.
parts: three powder-coated steel tube uprights against the wall with cap plates
wall bracket plates with lag bolts
five levels of cantilever arms with sleeve brackets, gussets, upturned end stops and rubber caps
stacks of 8 ft and 7 ft SPF 2x4s, 1x6s, 2x6s, 1x4 and 1x2 trim with sawn ends and grade stamps
planed oak, maple and walnut boards of mixed widths and lengths
two plywood offcuts leaning on the uprights below the bottom arms
floor foot plates with anchor bolts
a few grey old boards on the top arms
style: Home or small pro shop wall rack, black powder coat, a working stock of construction lumber and a few hardwood boards.
notes: Back at z = 0 (wall plane), faces +Z; size measured with boards overhanging the uprights.
